notes.title: June Update
notes.notes:
[h1]June Update - Stability & Gameplay Enhancements[/h1]

  [hr][/hr]

  [h2]🕹️ Controller & Input Improvements[/h2]

  [b]Enhanced Gamepad Support[/b]
  [list]
  [*]Gamepad controls added to pause menu
  [*]Full controller support for save/load operations
  [*]Improved Steam Input integration across all platforms
  [/list]

  [hr][/hr]

  [h2]🌳 New Gameplay Features[/h2]

  [b]Environmental System[/b]
  [list]
  [*]Interactive trees added to the world with [url=https://www.folklore.org/Round_Rects_Are_Everywhere.html]RoundRects (R.I.P. Bill Atkinson)[/url]
  [*]Environmental destruction mechanics
  [*]Visual enhancements with new vegetation
  [/list]

  [b]Expanded World[/b]
  [list]
  [*]Larger map areas to explore
  [*]Improved map interface with better text readability
  [*]New areas with unique content
  [/list]

  [hr][/hr]

  [h2]🤖 NPC & Dialog Improvements[/h2]

  [b]Enhanced NPC System[/b]
  [list]
  [*]Improved NPC behavior and pathfinding
  [*]Better collision detection for NPCs
  [*]New entity-based NPC system replacing tile-based NPCs
  [/list]

  [b]Dialog Enhancements[/b]
  [list]
  [*]New fortune teller character with dynamically generated dialog
  [*]Redesigned dialog UI with better visual presentation
  [*]Enhanced interaction system for smoother conversations
  [*]Improved memory management for dialog system
  [/list]

  [hr][/hr]

  [h2]🔧 Technical Improvements[/h2]

  [b]Build System Updates[/b]
  [list]
  [*]Switched to Clang compiler for better performance
  [*]AddressSanitizer enabled for improved stability
  [*]Cross-platform build fixes for Windows, Mac, and Linux
  [/list]

  [b]Circuit System Fixes[/b]
  [list]
  [*]Fixed circuit text reset issues
  [*]Improved memory handling in circuit puzzles
  [*]Better performance for complex circuits
  [/list]

  [hr][/hr]

  [h2]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h2]

  [list]
  [*]Fixed NPC spawning issues on certain maps
  [*]Resolved out-of-bounds memory access bugs
  [*]Fixed various casting issues for better stability
  [*]Audio system improvements and fixes
  [/list]

  [hr][/hr]

  [h2]💡 What This Means for Players[/h2]

  [expand type=details expanded=false]
  This update brings [b]major platform expansion[/b] and gameplay improvements:

  [list]
  [*][b]Richer World[/b] - Interactive environments with trees and expanded exploration areas
  [*][b]Smarter NPCs[/b] - More realistic behavior and better interactions
  [*][b]Improved Stability[/b] - Technical improvements for smoother gameplay
  [/list]

  The new features enhance:
  [list]
  [*]Environmental interaction and player choice
  [*]Dialog depth with new characters
  [*]Overall game stability and performance
  [/list]
  [/expand]

notes.title: May Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Major Update - Code Refactoring & Improvements[/h1]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🔧 Major Architecture Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Circuit System Fixes
[*]Save System Fixes
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]🔊 Audio System Enhancements[/h2]

[b]Audio System Overhaul[/b]
[list]
[*]New audio functionality and features
[*]Enhanced audio processing capabilities
[/list]

[b]Memory Leak Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed audio resource leaks
[*]Improved memory management in audio system
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🐧 Platform & Build Improvements[/h2]

[b]Linux Compatibility Fixes[/b] 
[list]
[*]Fixed game loading issues specific to Linux platform
[*]Improved cross-platform compatibility
[*]Refactored better platform support
[/list]


[hr][/hr]

[h2]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h2]

[b]Achievement System[/b] 
[list]
[*]Fixed excessive logging spam in achievement system
[*]Improved performance by reducing unnecessary log output
[/list]


[h2]💡 What This Means for Players[/h2]

[expand type=details expanded=false]
This update represents a significant [b]code refactoring effort[/b] focused on:

[list]
[*][b]Better Performance[/b] - Modular systems reduce overhead and improve game responsiveness
[*][b]Improved Stability[/b] - Fixed memory leaks and platform-specific issues
[*][b]Enhanced Audio[/b] - Better sound processing and resource management
[*][b]Cross-Platform Support[/b] - Improved Linux compatibility and build processes
[/list]

While these are primarily "under the hood" improvements, they lay the foundation for:
[list]
[*]Faster development of new features
[*]More stable gameplay experience
[*]Better mod support in the future
[*]Easier bug fixes and updates
[/list]
[/expand]

[hr][/hr]

[i]This refactoring effort demonstrates active development focused on code quality, maintainability, and cross-platform compatibility. The modular architecture will enable faster feature development and more stable releases going forward.[/i]
